title: MLPerf HPC：品質門檻與端到端達標時間
titleEn: MLPerf HPC: quality gates and end-to-end time to qualification
subcategoryTitle: 量測方法與科學成果驗收
summary: 使用原創合成資料研究「MLPerf HPC：品質門檻與端到端達標時間」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付事件表、checkpoint雜湊、品質曲線、split與seed政策；以可重算的第一次達標判定交接，不提供虛構的MLPerf認證分數。
summaryEn: Investigate MLPerf HPC: quality gates and end-to-end time to qualification using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver event tables, checkpoint hashes, quality trajectories, validation-split identity and seed policy. Handover a reproducible first-qualification decision without presenting a fabricated certified MLPerf score.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.
